text:
The key difference is in the book title for (a). The text gives the title as 'Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone', and Assistant A shortens it to "The Philosopher's Stone", which drops part of the name. Assistant B gives the full title, which is accurate.

For the main character, the text says "Harry". Assistant A writes "Harry Potter", which is the character's full name but not stated in the text apart from the title. Assistant B writes "Harry", matching the text exactly. Both are defensible, though B is more faithful to the extraction.

The remaining two lines are identical.

Assistant B is more accurate on the title, which is the clearer error.

[[B]]
